Order 
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.19/2023 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana District Sagar (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 376, 376(3), 506(2) of the IPC and Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act.

sentences.text: Later on he was arrested as he did not appear in the Court.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in a private job and has gone outside for doing work.
There is sufficient cause for his non-appearance.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
No application was filed before the Court for exemption from personal appearance.
If he has some work he ought to have filed an application for 2 MCRC-24041-2024 exemption.
Since applicant has violated the conditions of bail order, therefore, present application for grant of bail is dismissed.
7. Applicant is at liberty to file repeat bail application, if trial is not concluded within six months.
